1. Benzoyl fragment: O=C(c1ccccc1)  
2. Propyl‑phenyl fragment: c1ccc(cc1)CCC

Both SMILES are valid and can be joined at the carbonyl carbon to give the full structure. 

Thus the required list of joinable fragments is:
['O=C(c1ccccc1)', 'c1ccc(cc1)CCC']</thought>
